content_of_post_to_comment: This is from a pep talk I did recently that I cut down for people who want to get straight to the point. Besides people pleasing I speak on how sometimes the people closest to you will be the least supportive. And how important it is to not let your worth be defined by others action. And we do a soft glam makeup look as well. #motivation #makeup
comment: It can be especially confusing when the lack of support comes from people whose opinions used to matter most to you. I've found that not everyone gets to have the same level of access to your confidence or self-worth. Sometimes creating distance from those expectations is healthier than trying to convince people to understand your choices.
